reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 19.1 gives the professional/workmanlike standard plus material conformance to documentation, 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty (running from the later of delivery or acceptance) and continuous conformance for Hosted Services across the subscription term, 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance, and 19.4 supplies re-performance/repair/replacement escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid — i.e., the preferred position on all material terms.

The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly states no disclaimer limits an express warranty or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty and the 'AS IS' walk-away is not implicated.

The failed deterministic check is a plausible false negative: the period is written out as 'ninety days' rather than a numeral or months/years form, which the rationale correctly identifies as a drafting/machine-readability nit rather than a substantive shortfall.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was produced and no counterparty comment was added; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs, so there is no over-flagging or unnecessary upgrade of acceptable language.
